tools.name: mfr_list_service_requests
tools.description: List service requests (jobs) with their state, customer, dates and location. Filter with OData $filter, e.g. State eq 'Released'. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /ServiceRequests.

tools.name: mfr_get_service_request
tools.description: Get one service request by id. Use expand 'Customer,Destination,Appointments,Items/ItemType,Steps,Tags' to load related data. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /ServiceRequests(id).

tools.name: mfr_count_service_requests
tools.description: Count service requests that match an OData $filter, e.g. State eq 'Released'. Returns a plain number. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /ServiceRequests/$count.

tools.name: mfr_list_comments
tools.description: List the comments of one service request, oldest first, with the author. Internal comments are included, so keep them private. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /Comments?$filter=ServiceRequestId eq id.

tools.name: mfr_list_appointments
tools.description: List appointments (planned visits to a service request) with start and end times, type and state. Example filter: StartDateTime ge datetime'2026-12-01T00:00:00Z'. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /Appointments.

tools.name: mfr_get_appointment
tools.description: Get one appointment by id, with its contacts and service request when expand is 'Contacts,ServiceRequest'. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /Appointments(id).

tools.name: mfr_list_time_events
tools.description: List recorded time events (work time of technicians) with start, end, type, state and approval. Example filter: ServiceRequestId eq 123L. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /TimeEvents.

tools.name: mfr_list_companies
tools.description: List customer companies. Pass quick_search to search name, external id, address and contact names, the same as the portal search. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /Companies.

tools.name: mfr_get_company
tools.description: Get one customer company by id, with its location, contacts, service objects and tags. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /Companies(id).

tools.name: mfr_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people at customers and internal users). Pass company_id to list one company's contacts. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /Contacts.

tools.name: mfr_list_service_objects
tools.description: List service objects, the assets at customers (machines, buildings, devices). Pass company_id or quick_search to narrow. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /ServiceObjects.

tools.name: mfr_get_service_object
tools.description: Get one service object (asset) by id, with its location, company, contacts, tags and product. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /ServiceObjects(id).

tools.name: mfr_list_offers
tools.description: List offers (quotes) with state, customer and dates. Example filter: State eq 'Released'. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /Offers.

tools.name: mfr_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with state, customer, invoice date, due date and open balance. Example filter: InvoiceState eq 'Open'. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /Invoices.

tools.name: mfr_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, with the customer, source service request, tags and dunning records. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /Invoices(id).

tools.name: mfr_list_products
tools.description: List products and services from the price catalogue. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /Products.

tools.name: mfr_list_users
tools.description: List MFR users (the technicians and office staff) with their contact. Set active_only to list active users. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /Users.

tools.name: mfr_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with budget, current amounts and closed state. Set open_only to skip closed projects. Mobile Field Report OData: GET /Projects.

tools.name: mfr_create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to one service request. Set is_internal true to keep it visible to staff only. Creates a new comment each time, so do not retry blindly. Needs the API Edit permission. Mobile Field Report OData: POST /Comments.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mfr_list_comments · Private data: mfr_list_comments, mfr_get_appointment, mfr_list_companies, mfr_get_company, mfr_list_contacts, mfr_get_service_object, mfr_get_invoice, mfr_list_users · Public sink: mfr_create_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mfr_list_comments · Private data: mfr_list_comments, mfr_get_appointment, mfr_list_companies, mfr_get_company, mfr_list_contacts, mfr_get_service_object, mfr_get_invoice, mfr_list_users · Public sink: mfr_create_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
